llms.body:
# Depositphotos

> Depositphotos is a creative platform with millions of high-quality stock files: royalty-free images, videos, vectors, illustrations, music, and sound effects. Plus we offer unlimited AI-powered editing tools with every plan to speed up design workflow. Discover our large thematic collection of stock photography, and explore our stock video and music library to find exactly what you need for your projects. We're trusted by leading international companies that turn to our library for visual and audio content.

- [Depositphotos.com](https://depositphotos.com/): High-quality royalty-free stock photos, vector images, videos and music

## Features

> Depositphotos is a platform with 300+ million royalty-free files: photos, vectors, videos, and music. 5 million new uploads monthly. 600+ themed curated collections. Plus AI-powered editing tools to produce visuals from both text prompts and reference images and speed up creative workflow. Unlimited AI image generations with any plan. You can easily bring your ideas to life.

- [Stock Photography](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography.html): Millions of royalty-free stock photos and images on every topic
- [Vector Images](https://depositphotos.com/vector-images.html): Royalty-free stock vectors and scalable graphic assets
- [Stock Illustrations] (https://depositphotos.com/stock-illustrations-and-paintings.html): Royalty-free stock illustrations and paintings
- [Curated Collections](https://depositphotos.com/curated-collections.html): Themed curated collections of royalty-free files
- [Free Files](https://depositphotos.com/free-files.html): Free stock files
- [Stock Videos](https://depositphotos.com/stock-videos.html): Royalty-free HD and 4K stock footage
- [Editorial Stock Photos](https://depositphotos.com/editorial-stock-photos.html): News and event photography for editorial use
- [Music](https://depositphotos.com/music.html): Royal-free music, soundtracks and sound effects

## API

> API solutions to embed Depositphotos stock content, design tools, and AI features into your product.

- [API Suite](https://depositphotos.com/api-suite.html): Integrate Depositphotos and VistaCreate editor, libraries, and tools via API
- [Graphic Editor API](https://depositphotos.com/api-suite/graphic-editor.html): Add a customizable design editor to your platform via API
- [Stock Library API](https://depositphotos.com/api-suite/stock-library.html): Access 300+ million stock images, videos, and music via API
- [AI Tools API](https://depositphotos.com/api-suite/ai-tools.html): Use AI-powered tools via API. Tools include AI Image Generator, Background Remover, People Modificator, Object Remover, Object Replacer, Background Extender, Image Upscaler

## Tools

> Depositphotos offers AI tools, search features, and contributor resources for creative integration and automation.

- [AI Image Generator](https://depositphotos.com/ai-image-generator.html): Tool for AI text-to-image generation
- [Background Remover](https://depositphotos.com/bgremover.html): Free AI-based background remover
- [Image Upscaler](https://depositphotos.com/upscaler.html): AI-powered image upscaler
- [Search By Image](https://depositphotos.com/search-by-image.html): Reverse image search
- [Referral](https://depositphotos.com/referral.html): Referral program
- [AI Training Data](https://depositphotos.com/ai-training-data.html): Multimodal AI training datasets
- [Contributors Program](https://contributors.depositphotos.com/): How to sell your photos, illustrations and videos via Depositphotos

## Legal Information

> Legal terms, license agreements, contributor policies, and user rights for using Depositphotos content and services.

- [Legal Information](https://depositphotos.com/legal-information.html): Legal information and documents
- [Terms of Use](https://depositphotos.com/terms-of-use.html): Terms and conditions
- [Privacy Policy](https://depositphotos.com/privacy-policy.html): Privacy policy
- [License Terms](https://depositphotos.com/license.html): Standard and extended license agreement
- [Corporate Accounts](https://depositphotos.com/corporate-accounts.html): Business standard and extended license agreement
- [Membership Agreement](https://depositphotos.com/member-agreement.html): Membership agreement
- [License Comparison](https://depositphotos.com/license-comparison.html): Standard vs extended license comparison
- [Free License](https://depositphotos.com/free-license-with-attribution.html): Attributed free license agreement
- [Subscription Agreement](https://depositphotos.com/subscription-agreement.html): Subscription plan agreement
- [Digital Millennium Copyright Act](https://depositphotos.com/dmca.html): Digital Millennium Copyright Act takedown policy
- [Cancelation Policy](https://depositphotos.com/cancellation-policy.html): Return and cancelation policy
- [Referral Agreement](https://depositphotos.com/referral-legal.html): Referral agreement
- [API Agreement](https://depositphotos.com/api-agreement.html): API program agreement
- [Supply Agreement](https://depositphotos.com/supply-agreement.html): Supply agreement
- [Seller Price](https://depositphotos.com/seller-price.html): Contributor program to sell files online
- [Model Release](https://depositphotos.com/Model_release.pdf): Adult model release
- [Minor Model Release](https://depositphotos.com/Minor_model_release.pdf): Minor model release
- [Property Release](https://depositphotos.com/Property_release.pdf): Property release
- [Cashback Policy](https://depositphotos.com/cashback-policy.html): Cashback on plan purchases
- [DepositPhotos Rules for Responsible AI Use](https://depositphotos.com/ai-use-rules.html): DepositPhotos Rules for Responsible AI Use

## About Us

> Company overview, press resources, customer reviews, and career opportunities at Depositphotos.

- [About](https://depositphotos.com/about.html): Depositphotos company overview
- [Press](https://depositphotos.com/about/press.html): Brand assets and guidelines for press
- [Knowledge Hub](https://knowledge.depositphotos.com/): Stock-related guides, tips and tutorials
- [Careers](https://depositphotos.com/careers.html): Job openings at Depositphotos

## Pricing

> Depositphotos pricing plans for individuals, teams, and businesses, including options for photos, videos, and music.

- [Pricing](https://depositphotos.com/subscribe.html): Depositphotos plans and pricing
- [Enterprise plan](https://depositphotos.com/enterprise.html): Enterprise solutions for flexible licensing and managing content
- [Video Pricing](https://depositphotos.com/subscribe/video.html): Video subscription and packs pricing
- [Music Picing](https://depositphotos.com/subscribe/music.html): Music subscription and packs pricing
- [Corporate Pricing](https://depositphotos.com/subscribe/corporate.html): Business pricing plans
- [Corporate Video](https://depositphotos.com/subscribe/corporate/video.html): Business video pricing
- [Corporate Music](https://depositphotos.com/subscribe/corporate/music.html): Business music pricing

## Blog

> Articles on design, photography, trends, marketing, and technology from the Depositphotos Blog.

- [Blog](https://depositphotos.com/blog/): Depositphotos blog home page with all articles
- [News and events](https://blog.depositphotos.com/category/news-and-events): Company news and events
- [Inspiration](https://blog.depositphotos.com/category/inspiration): Articles about design, trends, art, colors, photography, branding for inspiration
- [Creativity](https://blog.depositphotos.com/category/creativity): Articles about design techniques, productivity, leadership, ideas for creativity
- [Marketing](https://blog.depositphotos.com/category/marketing): Articles about types of marketing like advertising, social media, brand, digital
- [Technology](https://blog.depositphotos.com/category/technology): Articles about tech, production, AI trends, image generation, software, online tools, AR, MR, VR

## Top Searches

> Popular search queries for photos, videos, vectors, illustrations, music, and sound effects.

- [Popular Searches]https://depositphotos.com/popular-searches.html): All popular search queries on Depositphotos
- [Photos](https://depositphotos.com/photos-searches.html): Popular searches for photos on Depositphotos
- [Vectors](https://depositphotos.com/vectors-searches.html): Popular searches for vectors on Depositphotos
- [Illustrations](https://depositphotos.com/illustrations-searches.html): Popular searches for illustrations on Depositphotos
- [Videos](https://depositphotos.com/videos-searches.html): Popular searches for videos on Depositphotos
- [Music](https://depositphotos.com/music-searches.html): Popular searches for music tracks on Depositphotos
- [Sound Effects](https://depositphotos.com/sound-effects-searches.html): Popular searches for sound effects on Depositphotos

## Photo Categories

> Browse stock photos by popular themes including nature, business, food, travel, animals, and more.

- [Holidays and Celebrations](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/holidays-and-celebrations.html): Popular holidays and celebrations images
- [Technology and Business](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/technology-and-business.html): Popular technology and business images
- [Food and Drink](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/food-and-drink.html): Popular food and drink images
- [Travel and Places](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/travel-and-places.html): Popular travel and places images
- [Nature and Environment](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/nature-and-environment.html): Popular nature and environment images
- [Wellbeing](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/emotional-and-social-well-being.html): Popular emotional and social well-being images
- [Construction](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/construction.html): Popular construction images
- [Textures and Backgrounds](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/textures-and-backgrounds.html): Popular textures and backgrounds images
- [Animals and Wildlife](https://depositphotos.com/stock-photography/animals-and-wildlife.html): Popular animals and wildlife images

## Account and Support

> Sign up or log in, find help articles, and contact Depositphotos support.

- [Login](https://depositphotos.com/login): Log in page
- [Signup](https://depositphotos.com/signup.html): Create an account
- [FAQ](https://depositphotos.com/faq.html): Help center with answers to frequently asked questions
- [Contact Us](https://depositphotos.com/contact-us.html): All ways to contact us with questions and offers
